fields.name: ACCT-ID
fields.description: Account identifier — unsigned zoned decimal, mapped to LongType for numeric operations

fields.name: ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS
fields.description: Active status flag (Y/N) — alphanumeric single character

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-BAL
fields.description: Current balance — signed zoned decimal with trailing overpunch sign and 2 implied decimals

fields.name: ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
fields.description: Credit limit — signed zoned decimal with trailing overpunch sign and 2 implied decimals

fields.name: ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT
fields.description: Cash credit limit — signed zoned decimal with trailing overpunch sign and 2 implied decimals

fields.name: ACCT-OPEN-DATE
fields.description: Account open date — alphanumeric date string (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD)

fields.name: ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE
fields.description: Account expiration date — alphanumeric date string (note: original typo preserved from copybook)

fields.name: ACCT-REISSUE-DATE
fields.description: Card reissue date — alphanumeric date string

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
fields.description: Current cycle credit amount — signed zoned decimal with trailing overpunch sign and 2 implied decimals

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
fields.description: Current cycle debit amount — signed zoned decimal with trailing overpunch sign and 2 implied decimals

fields.name: FILLER
fields.description: Reserved filler bytes — unused padding to reach 300-byte record length
